    AND o.purchased_at < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), monthly_variation AS (

    revenue,

FROM monthly_variation
WHERE month_start >= DATE '2017-02-01'

  SELECT

  JOIN olist.sellers s
    ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id

)

  c.state_code AS estado,
  SUM(fpv.faturamento) AS faturamento
FROM faturamento_por_vendedor fpv
JOIN olist.cities c
  ON c.city_id = fpv.city_id
GROUP BY c.state_code
ORDER BY faturamento DESC, estado ASC

    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY
    c.category_name_english,
    c.category_name
)
SELECT
  category_name_en AS category_name,
  category_name_original,
  distinct_orders,
  revenue
FROM category_metrics
ORDER BY revenue DESC, category_name_en ASC;

WITH item_sales AS (

    JOIN olist.products p

      ON cat.category_name = p.category_name

      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

    SELECT
